claims.statement: The first phase of the VAM-VAE backward integration project is expected to be commissioned in the first half of the year.
claims.quote: We expect to commission first phase in the first half of this year.

facts.statement: Gross margins reached an all-time high of about 45.6% in the fourth quarter.
facts.quote: taking our Gross Margins to almost an all-time high of about 45.6%, which is very strong.

facts.statement: New products contribute a substantial 17% of revenues.
facts.quote: new products are something which we have always looked at, and they have now contributed to a substantial 17% of revenues

facts.statement: The company added more than 6,000 retail touchpoints across the country over the year.
facts.quote: more than 6,000 retail touchpoints we have added across the country this year.

facts.statement: The international business reported PBT margins of about 8.5% for the quarter, marking a 370 bps year-on-year improvement.
facts.quote: PBT margins, which is about 8.5% for the quarter, which is a strong improvement by 370 bps year-on-year.

facts.statement: Industrial joint ventures include PPGAP for auto OE and APPPG for general industrial products.
facts.quote: today we have two joint ventures, as you are aware of one for the auto OE, which is called “PPGAP”. The other is for general industrial products, which is called “APPPG”.
